qa_pairs.question: What information is available to users under the "User Summary" tab in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the "User Summary" tab in the Metrix portal, users can find their quotas for different file systems, followed by a list of their 10 most recent tasks.

qa_pairs.question: How can a user access the detailed page for a specific task or view all their tasks from the "User Summary" tab?
qa_pairs.answer: From the "User Summary" tab, users can select a task by its number to access its detailed page. Alternatively, by clicking on "(Plus de détails)" (More details), they will be redirected to the "Task Statistics" tab, which displays all their tasks.
